raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Hey! Glad to finally talk to you. I want to ask you, what motivates you?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Hey John! Video games give me tons of joy and excitement, so they keep me motivated!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Cool, James! I'm a big video game fan too. They help me relax after a long day. What game are you currently enjoying the most?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: I'm totally into The Witcher 3 right now. The story and atmosphere are amazing. Have you tried it yet?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Haven't played it yet, but I hear it's awesome. Gonna give it a go. BTW, just signed up for a programming class. Have you ever done any programming?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Programming is an awesome skill. I tried it out one in college and now it`s all my life. Good luck in the class! Do you have any coding experience?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: I did a bit of coding in HTML and CSS a few years back. Thought I'd refresh those skills in this course. What languages do you like most and any projects you've done?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a computer screen showing a video game scene] I've worked with Python and C++. I've built a website and also created some game mods. Here is one example.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: That mod looks amazing! The graphics are awesome. What other programming languages have you worked with?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: I haven’t worked with any other programming languages, but I hope to work in the future.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Maybe in the future we will develop mobile applications together? Do you like the idea?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of two dogs are tied to a fence with a leash] It would be cool! For example, we could write some kind of application for dogs. By the way, my dogs.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Aww, they're adorable! What are the names of your pets? And what are your plans for the app?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Max and Daisy. Will be actually cool to build an app for dog walking and pet care. The goal is to connect pet owners with reliable dog walkers and provide helpful information on pet care.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Sounds good, James! Bet that app would find a lot of buyers. What sets it apart from other existing apps?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a notepad with a handwritten note on it] Thanks, John! The personal touch really sets it apart. Users can add their pup's preferences/needs - just like they were customizing it for them. Making it unique for each owner and pup.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: That's a great idea! Your pup is gonna love it. Speaking of personal touches, what motivates you to work on your programming projects?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a person holding a notebook with a list of things on it] Creating something and seeing it come to life gives me a great sense of accomplishment. It's an amazing feeling. I write down all my goals in a notebook. It's very satisfying to check off each one when it's done.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: What are you working on that has you feeling so accomplished?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a drawing of a girl in a plane] I'm working on something I've wanted to do since I was a kid. Even as a child, I made some sketches of the main character. Back then I was just drawing comics, but now I want to turn it into a computer game. It's a project that has me really excited.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Wow, James! That's amazing. What made you decide to work on it and create your own game?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: I'm always excited to combine my favorite passions: gaming and storytelling. It's great creating my own project and bringing my ideas to life, plus the challenge is really enjoyable!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a medical chart with instructions for the procedure] That sounds really fulfilling! Combining your passions to make something new must be so exciting. Can't wait to see the outcome.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Thanks John! It's super exciting. I'll keep you updated on the progress. Perhaps, thanks to your knowledge of HTML, I'll invite you to help with some things in my game.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: It will be great to work with you, James.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: I'll be looking forward to it. By the way, yesterday I went bowling and got 2 strikes. I love bowling!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: I'm sure you're very good at this. Unfortunately, I can’t share my love for him with you, my fingers are too big. Perhaps I should take up exercise, at least start going for a run in the morning. And I also don’t like bowling itself, to be honest.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: It's a pity, it would be nice to go play with you one day.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Well, I'm sure we can do something else. We can play slot machines and arcades, for example.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: The last time I played at the slot machines, I was so engrossed in the game that I didn't notice my wallet being taken out of my pocket. Sad story.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: I'm sorry to hear it. Well, I'll be nearby, I'll look after your pockets.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Still, maybe we can try something different?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Heard about VR gaming? It's pretty immersive. We can try it together!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: I tried it - it's crazy how real it feels! Have you given it a shot?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Tried it a few times, it's insane how immersive that experience can be. Can't wait to try it together with you.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Yeah, VR gaming is awesome! Let`s do it next Saturday!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Agreed, James!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Hey John, something awesome happened since we talked. I made a game avatar and joined a new platform. It's so fun exploring and chatting with other gamers - it's a whole new adventure every time! I feel like I'm part of a super cool online community.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Hey James, awesome! Glad you're enjoying it and connecting with others. Building a community is really cool, especially when you meet people who enjoy the same things.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Thanks, John! Connecting with other gamers has been great! We've shared tips, strategies, and stories about gaming. It's amazing how it brings people together, regardless of their backgrounds.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: That's incredible! It's so cool how gaming can bring people together and create a strong bond, regardless of their background.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Yeah, it's our shared language and passion. It's been a refuge for me in tough times.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Yeah, gaming always helps me escape stress. It's amazing how it calms me down during tough times.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Games are my go-to when I'm feeling overwhelmed. It's like therapy. I can relax, forget my troubles, and get lost in another world.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Gotcha. Gaming can be a great way to take a break and escape for a while. Anything new you've been into lately?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Lately, I've been checking out different styles of it. It's been fun to try something fresh and test myself in other ways. What about you, John? Any new hobbies recently?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: I've been getting into a new hobby recently. I bought a metal detector and walk along the beaches looking for something worthwhile.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Interesting, John! Sounds like an awesome immersive experience. Already found something interesting?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Mostly just bottle caps, but a couple of times I found coins, and once even a gold ring.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Cool, I wish you good luck in this matter! By the way, I've got something to show you.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Show me what you've got! What is it?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth] Check out this pic of my best buds having a blast in the park. They've brought so much joy to my life. My two dogs are the best pals ever, right?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: They look like they're having a blast! Can they do any tricks?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a dog laying on a bed with a name tag] They can do tricks like sit, stay, paw, and rollover. Here's a picture of Daisy waiting for a treat. I've done lots of training and they've picked it up fast. They're like my family.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Aww, they're adorable! Pets are the best - they must make life so much better. I want one so bad, but I'm not there yet. Someday!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: A pet would truly be great for you! They bring so much love and companionship. If you're interested, I can help find the perfect one for you - you'd make a great pet parent!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Cheers, James! Yeah, I'll keep that in mind. Appreciate the offer.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: No problem, John! Let me know whenever you need assistance. Take care!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Hey James, long time no see! I had a big win in my game last week - finally advanced to the next level! It was a huge confidence booster and felt like I'd really achieved something.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photography of a drum kit with a white drum and a black drum] Hey John, congrats on your win! Games can really boost confidence, huh? I'm challenging myself too - I'm learning this instrument, which has been quite the journey.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a drum kit sitting on top of a table] Thanks, James! I play drums too! Here's a pic of my set.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Wow, looking good! How long have you been playing?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: I've been playing for a month now, it's been tough but fun. How about you, how's it going?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: This is going great! I started a few days ago, so I'm still picking it up. Been at it daily and seeing improvements. It's tough but rewarding at the same time!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Nice work! Looks like you're doing great. Anything new in general that you'd recommend?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Thanks! I just got a new cutting-edge gaming system and the graphics are incredible. I've been playing all kinds of new games and it's been a great way to relax after work. Plus, I can connect with friends who share my passion for gaming.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photography of a crowded convention hall with a large crowd of people] Cool, James! Gaming is great for chilling out. Btw, since we last spoke, I had the chance to go to a gaming convention - it was amazing! Tried out loads of games, met developers, and even took part in a tournament - unreal! Check out this pic I took!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! What game was it for? Sounds like a dream!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: I played my favorite CS:GO game in an intense tournament. It was awesome to see all the skilled players competing.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Wow, that sounds cool! Gaming is awesome with all the competition. Must have been thrilling to watch those skilled players!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: It was indeed amazing! Watching those skilled players really inspired me to improve my own gaming skills.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Nice one, John! Learning from experienced gamers can really help you level up your skills. Keep it up!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: I'm always looking to up my game and hit new goals. That same commitment is true for my hobbies and other stuff. What have you been doing to stay motivated?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Setting small goals and tracking my progress helps me stay motivated and focused.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Nice one! Setting small goals and tracking progress is a great way to stay motivated - it helps you stay on track and celebrates progress. Anything specific you're working on or upcoming challenges you're pumped about?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: I'm getting into different types of games now, like RPGs and strategy games. It's really exciting!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Cool, James! That sounds exciting. Have fun exploring different genres of games!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: I'm super hyped to explore different game genres. Let's see what's in store!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Definitely! Trying new genres is always exciting. I can't wait to hear about your journey with them. Please let me know how it goes!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Got it, John! I'll keep you updated on my gaming adventures with the new genres. Have a good day!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Thanks! Can't wait to hear about it. Bye!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Hey James! Long time no chat. What's up? Been playing any new games lately?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a group of people posing for a picture] Hey John! Yeah, it's been a while. I've been busy, but I joined an online gaming tournament yesterday. It was so intense and fun! Here is a photo report.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: That online gaming tournament looks awesome! Glad you had a blast. How did it go for you?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a man in a costume standing in front of a sign] It was so much fun! I did pretty well in the tournament; I made it to the semis and won some rounds. It was such a rush! Here's a screenshot of my character.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Wow, awesome! Congrats on your performance and making it to the semifinals. How did the final rounds turn out?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a man in a costume holding a sword] Thanks John! The final rounds were tough. I tried my best but didn't make it. It was close, though, and I had a blast competing with talented players. Looking forward to the next tournament!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Met any famous player there?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a man sitting in a chair playing a video game] I met the whole team! It’s a pity I didn’t get a chance to take a photo with them, but one of them even gave me a couple of gaming tips.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Cool! I'm sure his advice will help you develop in the game.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a notepad with a pen and a glass of water] Yes, I'm sure of that too. Also, the whole team gave me autographs. I was very happy about this!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: How cool is this! What advice do you remember most?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a group of people standing around a table] The most important thing I remember is that you always need to communicate correctly with the team and never put your ego above team success.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Yeah, comms and teamwork are super important in gaming. When everyone works together, it's incredible what can be accomplished in a match. How do you usually communicate with your team?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: I usually use voice chat to communicate with my team. It's fast and helps us work together effectively.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Sounds like a good plan. It really helps with communication. What game do you like playing with your team?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a video game screen showing a robot and a robot] I've been playing my favourite game called Apex Legends with my team and it's intense! Check out this screenshot of us playing!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Man, Apex Legends looks tough! The graphics are unreal. How does it stack up against other games?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Apex Legends has awesome graphics and super fast-paced gameplay. It definitely stands out among other games.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Hmm, the speed of it definitely makes it fun! Are there any new games that you're looking forward to trying out?

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a video game cover of a video game] Yeah, I'm always excited to try new games. Thinking of trying RPGs like that or MOBAs. Sounds cool!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: RPGs and MOBAs can be awesome to experience an engaging story or have epic multiplayer fights. Let me know how you like them!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Sure thing, John! Can't wait to try out some new genres. I'll definitely let you know my thoughts once I give them a try.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Love hearing about it. Let's chat soon!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Sure John, I'll keep you updated on all the new games. Talk to you soon! Bye for now!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Let me know how it goes. Stay safe. Talk to you soon. Bye!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a dog and a cat sitting on a dog bed] Hey John! Long time no chat - I adopted a pup from a shelter in Stamford last week and my days have been so much happier with him in the fam. I named it Ned. Any progress on your gaming goals?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Hey James! Congrats on getting a pup! They really do make days brighter. I haven't made much progress with gaming lately, life's been busy with work and stuff but it's always nice to remember how happy gaming makes me. It's a good way to forget the stresses of life.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Thanks, John! Gaming really does help forget about the stresses of life. It's like heading into another world! Have you played any interesting games lately?

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a city at night with a view of the city] I'm playing this new RPG that has a really cool story and world. It's kinda like getting transported to a futuristic dystopia.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Sounds great! Will I like it? I'm always up for trying new games.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: [Image: a photo of a computer screen with a game on it] You'll love it! It has a fun story and an awesome world. Plus, it has some tough gameplay. However, the game is a little laggy and sometimes produces errors. Here is one of them that I came across yesterday.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: The game must still be raw. I'd rather wait until the bugs are completely fixed, and then I'll try it out.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Even with minor bugs, the game still looks great. The graphics are awesome and the gameplay is super immersive. I'm sure you should try it out now. I can send you a link.

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Okay, you convinced me. Well, I'll wait for the link then, thanks!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Cool, I'll send it to you. Let me know what you think after you check it out!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Cool, John! I'll check it out and let you know what I think. I'm excited to give it a try.

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Thanks, James! Excited to hear your thoughts. Have a great time!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: Cheers! Will do. Enjoy the gaming! Bye!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Bye for now!

raw_turns.speaker: James
raw_turns.text: See ya! Take care!

raw_turns.speaker: John
raw_turns.text: Take care!
